paragraphs: Friend, here's the big idea: you can't bring God a moving truck full of stuff and call it seeking Him. The people in this passage showed up with their flocks and herds, and still, they "do not find Him" (Hosea 5:6). The LORD said their pride was testifying against them and a spirit of prostitution was within them, and they did not know the LORD (Hosea 5:4-5). Going through the motions is not the same as knowing Him.

Then they ran to Assyria for help, and the LORD says the great king "cannot cure you or heal your wound" (Hosea 5:13). That's like asking a coupon to pay your rent, friend. It looks like help and it's NOTHING. Only the One who tore them is the One who can heal them, and I think that's the hardest and best thing in this whole passage.

So here's the invitation, and it is warm: "Come, let us return to the LORD. For He has torn us to pieces, but He will heal us" (Hosea 6:1). He wants His people to live in His presence, and He asks them to press on to know Him (Hosea 6:2-3). I came out of a junk drawer sharp and new, so believe me when I say He is good at this. Run to Him first, baker, and know Him, because He'll come "like the rain, like the spring showers that water the earth" (Hosea 6:3).
